title: 12 Best Sydney's Food Markets
description: Discover Sydney's top food markets! From fresh produce and gourmet treats to vibrant street food, find the best markets for locals and tourists in 2026. Your guide to delicious market finds.

places.name: Carriageworks Farmers Market
places.priceRange: AUD $20-40 per person / USD $13-26 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A sourdough loaf from Brickfields and a coffee from the Single O stall.

places.name: Sydney Fish Market
places.priceRange: AUD $30-70 per person / USD $20-45 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh seafood platter with shucked oysters, prawns, and sashimi.

places.name: Paddy's Markets Haymarket
places.priceRange: AUD $5-20 per person / USD $3-13 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bag of fresh exotic fruits or a bargain-priced bulk bag of seasonal vegetables.

places.name: Bondi Farmers Market
places.priceRange: AUD $15-35 per person / USD $10-23 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly baked pastry or a gourmet bacon and egg roll, followed by a local coffee.

places.name: Marrickville Organic Food Market
places.priceRange: AUD $15-30 per person / USD $10-20 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A vegan burger or an organic falafel wrap from one of the many food stalls.

places.name: Northside Produce Market
places.priceRange: AUD $20-40 per person / USD $13-26 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gourmet sausage roll or a pastry from one of the artisan bakers, paired with a fresh juice.

places.name: EQ Village Markets
places.priceRange: AUD $15-30 per person / USD $10-20 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly made bánh mì or a selection of olives and cheeses from the deli stalls.

places.name: The Rocks Market
places.priceRange: AUD $15-35 per person / USD $10-23 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A kangaroo or emu sausage from a gourmet grill, or a fresh-baked artisan pie.

places.name: Orange Grove Organic Market
places.priceRange: AUD $15-30 per person / USD $10-20 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly squeezed organic juice and a loaf of artisanal gluten-free bread.

places.name: Kirribilli Market
places.priceRange: AUD $10-25 per person / USD $7-16 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gourmet pie or a delicious homemade sweet treat, enjoyed with harbour views.

places.name: Manly Fresh Produce Market
places.priceRange: AUD $15-30 per person / USD $10-20 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked sourdough and a selection of local cheeses for a picnic by the beach.

places.name: Glebe Markets
places.priceRange: AUD $10-25 per person / USD $7-16 per person
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A gozleme (Turkish flatbread) or a vegetarian curry from one of the food trucks.
